izzyondroid:com.onyx.darie.calin.gentleg.description:
Adds a quick settings tile 💡 to turn the frontlight on or off on Onyx BOOX E-readers running Android 9+.
 When you long tap this new quick settings tile, you can set warmth and brightness independently, instead of having to manually combine warm brightness with cold brightness.
 In the warmth & brightness dialog, you get to choose between three configurations. Initially, you get three presets:
 Night, to be used in a dark bedroom.
 Dawn, to be used at first daylight, before sunrise
 Day, to be used at day time indoors or in the shade
 You can easily adjust the brightness or warmth on any of the three configurations. Just play with the sliders or with the fine tune buttons to the left and right of the sliders, and your changes are auto-saved.
 Should you use the frontlight under any completely different circumstance, say on the subway, you can easily rename any of these three configurations to Subway and fine tune the warmth and brightness to your daily commute needs. At any time, you can go back to any of the presets.
 ⚠️With this app, you have finer control over the frontlight than with the native sliders. Most of the time, the native controls will show the lights are toggled on, but the cold / warm sliders will stay at zero, because the setting is not one of their fixed increments.
 The Onyx Slider configuration is there just so changing the frontlight settings via the system sliders doesn't silently change your current configuration. The Onyx Slider configuration is also a good way to get your system sliders back to a known good state, see the warning above.

3. COMPLETE 74XX IC DATASHEET CATALOG

fdroid:io.github.benediktburger.cycleapp.description:
This app helps you track menstrual-cycle symptoms day by day and evaluate
your records manually following the NER rules (Rötzer), in the spirit of
INER.
The evaluation stays with you: you place every mark on the cycle chart
yourself. The app only does the arithmetic you would otherwise do by hand
— the baseline drawn from the six prior low measurements, counts, lines,
and statistics (cycle and phase lengths). It computes and displays; it
never suggests and never decides. For a reliable interpretation of
fertility you need knowledge of the method — from a textbook or a course.
The app is in beta: storage and evaluation are stable, but screens,
controls, and features are still being revised, and the name, icon, and
colour scheme are not final. Data loss cannot be ruled out entirely —
export your data regularly and before every update via Export in the
settings.
Features:
• All your data stays on the device — no cloud, no analytics, no network
 permission.
• Language: German and English — follows your system language or can be
 switched in the app.
• Daily entry of basal body temperature (with exclusion flags for
 disturbances such as illness, alcohol or a late bedtime), bleeding,
 cervical mucus in the NER shorthand notation (t, Ø, f, S), optional
 cervix, pain, sexual intercourse, and notes.
• Evaluation tools: first temperature above the baseline, count of low
 measurements, mucus peak day, sympto-thermal fertile window, exclusion
 of disturbed days.
• PDF export: export the evaluation as a print-ready PDF.
• Import from Drip: bring in existing data from the Drip app (CSV export).
• Export and Import in the settings — your data always stays
 your own.
• Open source; licensed under Apache-2.0.
Note: "NER Cycle App" is a working title; the final name has not been
chosen yet.

firefox-addons:3011890.summary: Dual subtitles and AI subtitle translator for YouTube, Crunchyroll, Vimeo, Bilibili, Dailymotion and any HTML5 player. Detect, translate, download or AI-dub subtitles. Upload your own file for Netflix. Free translation, no API key needed.
firefox-addons:3011890.description:
VoxSub is an AI subtitle translator and all-in-one subtitle toolkit for HTML5 video players. Translate subtitles, show dual subtitles (bilingual captions), dub videos with AI voice, filter words, rewrite, search, synchronize, download, and upload subtitle files while you watch.
VoxSub works on any HTML5 video player, even on websites that are not officially supported: if the player exposes its subtitles, VoxSub detects them so you can translate or download them. Supported sites include YouTube, Crunchyroll, Vimeo, Dailymotion, and Bilibili.
Floating Toolbar
A small floating toolbar appears on the video player, so you can translate subtitles or start dubbing in one click, without opening the extension. Use the shield icon to open your subtitle filter profiles, or open the full Control Panel whenever you need more options.
How it works
 Detect: VoxSub automatically finds the subtitles available on the player, such as YouTube subtitles.
 Translate: translation works automatically with no API key required. For AI translation and rewriting, you can optionally connect Gemini with your own free API key.
 Upload: if a video has no subtitles, or the site doesn't expose them (such as Netflix), upload your own subtitle file and use the same tools on it.
 Dub: AI dubbing works on any player, using detected subtitles or a file you uploaded.
Whether you're learning a new language, watching international content, improving subtitle quality, or creating your own subtitle experience, VoxSub gives you complete control over subtitles without interrupting playback.
Key Features
Dual Subtitles (Bilingual Captions)
Display two subtitle tracks at the same time, such as the original subtitles alongside a translated or rewritten version.
Perfect for language learning, bilingual viewing, and subtitle comparison.
AI Subtitle Translation & Rewriting
Translate subtitles into supported languages or rewrite them using your preferred AI service.
Simplify text, adjust writing style, change tone, rewrite subtitles into different dialects, or create your own custom translation instructions.
AI Voice Dubbing (AI Dubbing)
Turn subtitles into spoken audio on any player, using detected subtitles or your own subtitle file.
Two voice options: a free engine that needs no API key, or ElevenLabs for higher-quality voices. ElevenLabs works with your own API key, and its free plan includes a monthly character allowance with no credit card required.
Control the dubbing speed, dubbed voice volume, and original video volume, with advanced voice settings for ElevenLabs.
Subtitle Filter Profiles (Shield)
Click the shield icon to open your subtitle filter. Create custom profiles that automatically:
 Replace words or phrases in the subtitles with your own text.
 Mute the audio when a chosen word is spoken.
 Skip the subtitle segment where a chosen word appears.
A useful word filter and profanity filter for family-friendly viewing, kids, anime, movies, or any personal preference.
Quick Edit: select any word in the subtitles while you watch and choose Mute, Skip, or Replace instantly, with no setup.
Live counters show how many words were replaced, segments skipped, and audio parts muted. Adjust the skip timing to fit your needs.
Build separate profiles for different kinds of content and switch between them in one click. Import and export your profiles as JSON files. All rules are stored locally in your browser.
Subtitle Downloader & Upload
Download detected subtitles from HTML5 video players, regardless of subtitle length.
Upload your own subtitle files to any supported player and use every VoxSub feature, including translation, rewriting, searching, synchronization, filtering, dual subtitles, dubbing, and subtitle customization. This also works on sites like Netflix, where subtitles can't be detected automatically.
Subtitle Search
Search instantly inside detected or uploaded subtitles.
Jump directly to any matching subtitle line or timestamp without manually searching through the video.
Perfect for studying, reviewing conversations, or finding specific scenes in seconds.
Subtitle Synchronization
Fix subtitle delays in seconds, with two options:
 Quick Sync: a simple timing slider to shift subtitles earlier or later.
 Advanced Sync: pick two reference points (Point 1 and Point 2) from the subtitle cue list, which shows the timing of every line, and search inside it to find the right lines fast.
An easy way to fix subtitle timing without manually editing subtitle files.
Subtitle Customization
Customize how subtitles look from the Control Panel: background opacity, font size, bold text, color, and position on screen. You can also hide the subtitles or the video itself when you only want to listen.
Automatic Subtitle Detection
VoxSub automatically detects subtitles on HTML5 video players, including YouTube, Crunchyroll, Vimeo, Dailymotion, and Bilibili.
If subtitles are unavailable, simply upload your own subtitle file and continue using all subtitle tools without limitations.
Translation Engines & Languages
Translate subtitles into 40 languages, or translate an existing translation again into a different language.
Switch between three translation engines directly from the floating toolbar on the video: Quick, Microsoft, and Gemini. If a result isn't what you wanted, change the engine and translate again without leaving the video.
Translator Guidance
Set your own translation style while you watch. Open the guidance box from the floating toolbar and describe the style you want, such as a casual tone, simpler wording, or a specific dialect. Your instructions are applied to the translation, without leaving the video. Describe the style only; you choose the language from the list after saving.
More Tools in the Control Panel
Video Adjustments: change brightness, contrast, and saturation to make any video look better.
Audio Boost: boost the volume of quiet videos with one simple slider.
Lightweight & Fast
Designed to stay lightweight, responsive, and efficient while watching videos.
Privacy
Subtitle profiles, settings, and rules are stored locally in your browser.
When you translate or dub, subtitle text is sent to the translation or voice service in use, including Gemini or ElevenLabs if you add your own API key. Details are in the Privacy Policy.
AI features run only when you choose to use them.

Tab Counter Plus shows the number of tabs in each Firefox window. It's efficient and customizable.
 Features 
 Can count the number of tabs in each window or among all.
 Two display modes: SVG text icon or WebExtension badge.
 Colors and title are customizable.
 Works with multiple windows side by side (not easy due to WebExtension limitations).
 Small performance impact. Most other tab counter extensions continuously query all tabs to count them. That's an expensive operation, which Tab Counter Plus avoids by storing the numbers and updating them on various events.
 Intelligent debouncing. If lots of tabs are opened or closed in a short period of time (e.g. when restoring previous session during startup), the webextension will delay the update of the counter.
 Very fast. Tab Counter Plus avoids asynchronicity as much as possible in order to achieve a faster update of the counter. In particular, no delay when removing tabs (usual in other tab counter due to WebExtension limitations).
 Light-weight. Coded in fast vanilla-js, no bloating libraries.
 I designed and implemented a new WebExtension feature that allows to achieve all the above in a much more robust, simple and efficient way. It's included since Tab Counter Plus version 2.0, targetting Firefox 62.
 Why another tab counter add-on? 
The great Michael Kraft's Tab Counter doesn't work in Firefox Quantum. Some tab counter WebExtensions appeared, but WebExtension limitations made it difficult to create a good tab counter. Therefore, I decided to write my own extension which bypasses the issues as best as I could, and in parallel I started adding new WebExtension features to solve them.

firefox-addons:870010.name: ReloadMatic: Automatic Tab Refresh
firefox-addons:870010.summary: ReloadMatic automates the periodic reloading / refreshing of browser tabs. It offers cache control, custom intervals, POST support and many other features. It also integrates with browser features such as tab restore, pinning, and incognito mode.
firefox-addons:870010.description:
Highlights 
Ready for FF 57.0. "Smart timing" feature prevents scheduled reloads from accidentially interrupting the user. Ability to set custom reload intervals. Ability to reload with caches disabled, once or repeatedly. Support refreshing POST data after form submission. Support for tab restore. Randomized intervals. Remember settings for URL. Most features optional. Configurable defaults. No restart needed after installation.
 Note for ReloadEvery users 
In contrast to ReloadEvery, ReloadMatic will stop reloading a tab when its URL changes. If you want the old behavior back, enable the "Sticky Reload" option. You can make it turned on by default in the addon settings.
 Usage 
To use this add-on, simply right-click anywhere in a webpage and select options under "Reload" of the context menu. Clicking on a tab header is also possible in the newest version, but requires Firefox 60 or newer. As for all the options and other details, see the F.A.Q. included in the addon's menu after installation.
 What are the permissions used for? 
When you install this plugin, your browser will ask for the following permissions.
 Access your data for all websites - The permission will allow ReloadMatic to retrieve HTTP status codes which is used to tell if the page was loaded successfully. Used for the "Only if unsuccessful" feature. Also needed to capture POST data for resubmission.
 Access browser tabs - It allows to associate and differentiate settings per tab, for example to keep a different reload period for each of your tabs.
 Access recently closed tabs - Allows to restore reload- and other settings if you reopen an accidentially closed tab.
 Access browser activity during navigation - Used to catch navigation events, so that page reloading can be toggled on/off based on user actions.
 Access browsing history - There are some pages that cannot be reloaded properly without adding new (unwanted) items to your browser history. This permission allows the addon to readjust your history in such cases to keep it tidy and correct.

Do share your feedback and help us improve Desh Marathi Keyboard. And don't forget to leave a review if you like it.

Exif Lens is an EXIF viewer, EXIF editor and metadata remover for iPhone, iPad and Mac. See when and where a photo was taken, change its date, location and camera data, and remove its location or all metadata before you share it — on your device.
Free Privacy Tools:
• Remove Location or All Metadata: From one photo or a whole selection, and from MOV and MP4 videos too.
• Share Clean: Share or save a copy without its location or without any metadata.
• From Any App: Choose Exif Lens in the share sheet to check a photo's details and pass it on clean, or open it inside Photos.
Exif Lens Pro Editing:
• Lossless by Design: Dates and places are set through Photos without touching the image, and edits to files keep the original pixels. If a library photo has to be saved again, Exif Lens asks first. HEIC stays HEIC, and depth, Portrait mattes and the HDR gain map are kept.
• Change Photo Date & Time: Edit the capture date, shift times, or move photos into another time zone.
• Edit GPS Location: Place a photo on a live map (geotag) and set which way the camera faced.
• Camera Data Control: Edit ISO, aperture, shutter speed, lens details and shooting modes.
• The Full Record: Edit title, headline, description, keywords, creator, copyright, credit and source.
• Batch Editing: Edit fields across many photos at once, with "Multiple values" where they differ.
• Copy & Paste: Copy fields from one photo onto others.
Everywhere You Work:
• iPhone, iPad and Mac: A three-column library with albums and filters, and on Mac, full menus, keyboard shortcuts and multiple windows.
• Files & Finder: Open, edit and rename photos in place, and export clean copies to any folder.
• Shortcuts: Remove location, remove metadata, set dates and shift times in your own automations.
• Undo & Revert: Undo an edit, or return any photo in your library to its original.
• 45 Languages: Exif Lens speaks 45 languages, from Arabic and Hindi to Japanese and Vietnamese, with right-to-left layouts for Arabic, Hebrew and Urdu.
Private by design: everything runs on your device. No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
Exif Lens Pro
